name: Fang Bo
notes: Retired in 2021 and came back in April 2026 to play for Kazakhstan; under the terms of his comeback he does not play the Olympics, World Championships or World Cup. Won WTT Contender Istanbul in November 2026 as a wild card ranked 160th, beating Kang Dongsoo 4-1 in the final, his first international singles title since 2013.
